composer-height.$description: Minimum height of the composer field and the rate-limit notice. Fits a 32px button with inset-sm above and below.

message-gap.$description: Vertical gap between items in the message log.

message-max-width.$description: Maximum bubble width. Bubbles never exceed the log width.

message-user-background.$description: User bubble fill. Override with chat.message-user-text to keep 4.5:1.

message-assistant-background.$description: Assistant and pending bubble fill. Pairs with text-primary.
